verdict.rationale: Intel markets Copilot+ integration enabling voice commands ('Say it and Copilot+ helps do it... Use voice commands to get answers, edit content') as a feature enabled by this chip's NPU/AI engines, but this is an OS/software-layer capability (Copilot+), not something the CPU itself directly executes, and no independent or hands-on verification of natural-language command operation is provided. Missing for 10: hands-on demonstration of voice/natural-language control, independent corroboration beyond marketing copy, and detail on scope/limits of the feature.
